title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：postcard　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 postcard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the postman ① sent the postcard that no sender in the office would have counted, and he said the sending was the whole of the week. The ② postcard, meaning the card itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a postcard, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ postcard in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ postcard at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A postcard, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the postman said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the postcard was the whole of the matter, meaning the greeting and not the card. The ⑥ postcard, meaning the greeting and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; postcard, he said, is either something you send or the only word that means both a card and a greeting. He said the greeting is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ postcard had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ postcard of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of counting; postcard, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ postcard I remember is the card counted in the list, which closed in 1991 and is still counted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ postcard, my mother said in 1993, is the only card that improves by being counted; every postcard, she said, is a greeting that has agreed to look like a card. She said the greeting was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 明信片（指邮局里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 明信片（指那张明信片本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：send the postcard 寄这一张明信片
D. n. 明信片（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 明信片之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的明信片之事）
F. n. 明信片（指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一张）
G. n. 明信片、问候（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 问候（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sent the postcard that no sender in the office would have counted
The postcard, meaning the card itself and not the envelope
the postcard at the far box
the postcard was the whole of the matter
the postcard had become a line in a list
The postcard of the whole thing
A postcard, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: send the postcard 意为“寄这一张明信片”，1984 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯清点的一张明信片做了一遍。
postcard 意为“明信片”，指那张明信片本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
postcard 意为“明信片”，指邮局里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
postcard 意为“明信片”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
postcard 意为“明信片、问候”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张问候就是那件事的全部。
postcard 意为“问候”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张明信片，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
postcard 意为“明信片”，指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一张，到 1989 年这一张成了收发清单里的一行。
postcard 意为“明信片之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的明信片之事是一处邮局和三个星期的清点。
postcard 意为“明信片”，我记得的是收发清单里清点过的那一张，1991 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一张。
postcard 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，明信片是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的明信片。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年那位邮差寄了邮局里没有一位寄信人肯清点的一张明信片，他说这一遍才是那个星期的全部。（send the postcard）
那张明信片，指的是那张明信片本身而不是薄薄的信封，经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。（postcard）
那处邮局里每一张明信片旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。（postcard）
最远那只信箱那张明信片，指的是他们留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（postcard）
叔叔说这张问候就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那张明信片。（postcard）
1993 年母亲说，明信片是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的明信片。（postcard）
